Description: Welder helper sustained 2cm superficial laceration to left palm while handling bevel cleaning wire brush
Root_Cause: Inadequate glove cut resistance level (Cut Level 1 worn instead of Level 5)
Corrective_Action: Mandatory issue of Cut Level 5 Kevlar reinforced gloves; toolbox talk on hand safety

Description: Rigger experienced dizziness headache and mild nausea during high ambient temperature (39C)
Root_Cause: Insufficient electrolyte intake and skipped scheduled rest rotation during heat advisory
Corrective_Action: Rest in air-conditioned rest shelter with oral rehydration salts; mandatory 15min/hr heat break rotation enforced

Description: Subcontractor pickup truck backed into stationary water tanker bumper causing dented tailgate and broken tail light
Root_Cause: Driver failed to utilize spotter in congested junction and reverse camera obscured by mud
Corrective_Action: Cleaned reversing cameras; re-briefed policy requiring dedicated spotter when reversing on ROW access roads

Description: Hydraulic hose ruptured on CAT 336 excavator releasing approx 18 liters of hydraulic oil onto ROW subgrade
Root_Cause: Hose abrasion against chassis bracket due to missing rubber protective sleeve
Corrective_Action: Equipment shut down immediately; spill contained with absorbent booms/pads; contaminated soil excavated and barreled

Description: 24in pipe joint slipped from vacuum lifter suction pad from height of 30cm during stack placement; landed on timber dunnage
Root_Cause: Sudden drop in auxiliary battery voltage powering vacuum seal pump
Corrective_Action: Replaced faulty backup battery; instituted daily vacuum seal decay pressure check prior to shift start

Description: 12m section of un-shored trench wall sloughed into trench bottom following overnight rain; no personnel in trench
Root_Cause: Soil saturation reducing cohesion; trench cut at steeper slope (0.75:1) than geotechnical recommendation (1.5:1)
Corrective_Action: Revised trench slope to 1.5:1; mandatory competent person inspection and permit re-authorization after rainfall events

Description: Bentonite drilling fluid return pit overflowed approx 45 liters of mud slurry onto access track berm during reaming surge
Root_Cause: Mud return line blockage combined with sudden formation surge during HDD reamer pass
Corrective_Action: Vacuum suction truck recovered slurry; earth bund heightened to 1.2m around return pit; silt fence reinforced

Description: Grinder operator reported foreign particle in right eye after high wind gust deflected grinding dust under safety glasses
Root_Cause: Standard safety glasses worn without tight-fitting foam gasket or face shield during high crosswinds
Corrective_Action: Eye flushed at field clinic; eye wash administered; mandatory full face shield and gasketed goggles during outdoor grinding

Description: Reversing 10T tipper struck frame of 150kVA stationary generator damaging sheet metal housing; no fuel leak
Root_Cause: Tipper reverse beeper defective; driver reversed without designated banksman
Corrective_Action: Repaired reverse alarm; installed concrete jersey barriers around all stationary generators at PS-1

Description: Sideboom tractor track slid 0.8m down wet clay embankment during pipe traversal; operator regained control on timber mats
Root_Cause: Slick soft clay conditions after rain without adequate bog matting under track
Corrective_Action: Extended timber swamp matting across all wet clay ROW sections prior to heavy equipment travel

Description: Diesel fuel drip of approx 4 liters occurred during fuel bowser nozzle disconnect into generator day-tank
Root_Cause: Worn dry-break coupling O-ring on fuel delivery nozzle
Corrective_Action: Replaced nozzle seal; drip tray placed under connection; contaminated gravel scooped into hazardous waste drum

Description: Welder assistant experienced mild arc-eye flash sensation after looking towards adjacent welding rig CW-07
Root_Cause: Inadequate flash curtain barrier between simultaneous welding bays on joint lineup
Corrective_Action: Erected opaque fire-retardant welding screens between adjacent welding stations; issued shade 5 auxiliary safety glasses
